syft-npm-alias.cdx.json: `syft 1.51.1 dir:<sample>` over a synthetic package.json/package-lock.json declaring `"legacy-swc-helpers": "npm:@swc/helpers@0.4.14"` (the npm-alias false positive dependency-watch used to refute by hand) and lodash 4.17.20, recorded 2026-10-23; the scan path is replaced by `/sample`.
feeds/: public feed payloads fetched 2026-10-23, trimmed (public data, no estate data). `epss_scores-current.csv` is the EPSS CSV's header lines plus four rows (gzipped by the tests); `known_exploited_vulnerabilities.json` is the CISA KEV catalog's header plus two entries (one with known ransomware use); `rh_cve_page.json` is one page (`per_page=3`) of `https://access.redhat.com/hydra/rest/securitydata/cve.json`.

cvss/: public advisory documents fetched 2026-11-16 (public data, no estate data), trimmed to the fields the CVSS parsers read, values unchanged. `nvd-CVE-2026-9277.json` and `nvd-CVE-2021-44228.json` are NVD API 2.0 records (`/rest/json/cves/2.0?cveId=`) reduced to `id`, `sourceIdentifier`, `vulnStatus` and `metrics`: 9277 has no NIST score (Deferred), only its CNA's 3.1 and 4.0 and another source's 3.1; 44228 has NIST's Primary 3.1 and 2.0 and CISA's ADP 3.1. `osv-GHSA-jfh8-c2jp-5v3q.json` and `osv-CVE-2026-9277.json` are OSV records (`api.osv.dev/v1/vulns/`) reduced to `id`, `aliases`, `modified`, `severity`, `database_specific`. `rhcve-CVE-2021-44228.json` is the Red Hat Security Data API record reduced to `name`, `threat_severity`, `cvss3`. `csaf-cve-2021-44228.json` is Red Hat's CSAF VEX document reduced to its tracking id and `vulnerabilities[].cve`/`scores`, each score's product list cut to two.
